content: Implementation Details We randomly divide the dataset into training, validation and testing set in a $0.6 : 0.2 : 0.2$ ratio. For G-BERT, the hyperparameters are adjusted on evaluation set: (1) GAT part: input embedding dimension as 75, number of attention heads as 4; (2) BERT part: hidden dimension as 300, dimension of position-wise feed-forward networks as 300, 2 hidden layers with 4 attention heads for each layer. Specially, we alternated the pre-training with 5 epochs and fine-tuning procedure with 5 epochs for 15 times to stabilize the training procedure.
